facts.business: NPR Finance Limited is a non-deposit taking Base Layer NBFC engaged in financing activities including group loan financing and investment in shares and securities, with some real estate sector exposure.
key_risks: Credit risk from delays in repayment by borrowers affecting income recognition and cash flows
Real estate sector risks including market demand fluctuations, property price changes, construction cost increases, statutory approval delays, and project execution risks
Changes in government policies, taxation, and regulatory framework
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on an arms-length basis and in the ordinary course of business. The Company has a Policy on Related Party Transactions and Materiality of Related Party Transactions. Shareholder approval was obtained at the 36th AGM on 11th September 2025 for various related party transactions. The Audit Committee granted omnibus approval on 12th February 2026 subject to maximum permissible threshold limits.
